description: Test fixtures for kmptoolkit-haptics: RecordingHapticFeedback, a HapticFeedback double that records every requested HapticType and lets a test dictate the HapticResult handed back. Pick this module as a testImplementation dependency alongside kmptoolkit-haptics when you want to assert which haptics a screen fires, and how it behaves when the device reports no vibrator or a missing permission.
